mainEntity.name: Is a consultation the right first step if I am not sure which route fits me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many people book a consultation because they need clarity before choosing a route, paying for the wrong service, or moving too quickly without understanding the bigger picture.

mainEntity.name: What can Immigrate to Brazil help me understand in a consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A consultation can help you understand which options may fit, what risks or timing issues matter most, what should happen first, and where more focused support may be needed afterward.

mainEntity.name: Do I need every document ready before I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You do not need a perfect file before booking. What helps most is a clear summary of your situation, your main questions, and any key documents or timing details you already have.

mainEntity.name: How does booking and confirmation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consultation requests are reviewed manually. Payment, proof, and scheduling are handled in sequence, and a time is only treated as confirmed after manual confirmation in writing.

After the consultation, the next step depends on your situation. That may mean moving into a clearer plan, preparing for a service, gathering more information, or deciding that a different direction makes more sense.
